title: Breaching Security
description: Astrid directs you to Gabriella for a contract to kill Gaius Maro, son of the Penitus Oculatus commander, and plant an incriminating letter on his body to disrupt the Emperor's security. Killing Gaius in a major city earns a bonus reward.

base_facts: I lead the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
The next step in our plan involves the Emperor's security detail.

SPEAK_WITH_GABRIELLA: I have sent the listener to Gabriella for the next contract details.
BREACHING_SECURITY_COMPLETE: Gaius Maro is dead and the letter planted. Commander Maro's security plan is in ruins.
Quest complete: Gaius Maro is dead and the letter planted, crippling the Emperor's security and ruining Commander Maro.

Detailed Walkthrough [ edit ] Sins of the Father [ edit ] When you return from your fateful visit to Vittoria Vici's wedding , you will find a gleeful Astrid ready to move onto the next phase of the plan.
This is the schedule as it appears in game that you steal from the Penitus Oculatus Outpost : The Stalker [ edit ] Don't be afraid to simply wait for a day and follow Gaius around.

base_facts: I provide contract details and guidance for Brotherhood operations.
Gaius Maro is the son of Commander Maro, head of the Penitus Oculatus.

CONTRACT_RECEIVED: Kill Gaius Maro and plant the incriminating letter on his body to frame him.
